applications.name: Power Suppression
applications.description: Whenever a Science Attacker activates a Special Attack, they have a 100% chance to Enervate the Defender for 6 second(s), preventing them from gaining Power when struck. Whenever this Enervate would expire, it consumes one Debuff on the Defender to reapply itself.

applications.name: Redlining - 3
applications.description: While the Attacker has more than 33% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by 100%. If the Attacker has more than 75% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.
applications.rawDescription: While the Attacker has more than {1}% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by {0}%. If the Attacker has more than {2}% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.

applications.name: Arms Race
applications.description:
Both the Attacker and Defender gain a Passive Fury during their Special Attacks based on the Defender's Power.
While below 1 Bar of Power, they gain +25% Attack.
While between 1 and 2 Bars of Power, they gain +75% Attack.
While above 2 Bars of Power, they gain +200% Attack.

applications.description: Every 15 second(s) the Defender gains a Power Gain Passive, granting [16982bff]15%[-] of Max Power over 8 second(s).
applications.rawDescription: Every {0} second(s) the Defender gains a Power Gain Passive, granting [16982bff]{1}%[-] of Max Power over {2} second(s).

applications.name: Bubble Shield - 3
applications.description: Each time the Attacker Blocks an attack, they are inflicted with an indefinite Bubble Shield Passive, reducing their Block Proficiency by 6%. Every 10 stacks makes the Defender's next attack Passively [k=glossary/unblockable]Unblockable[/k].
